sql: SELECT y.trip_date, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.total_amount END) AS target_total_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' AND d.d_dow = 1 THEN y.total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_total_amount, w.prcp_mm, w.snow_mm, w.tmax_c, w.tmin_c FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date JOIN whybot.nyc_weather_daily w ON w.obs_date = y.trip_date WHERE y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31' AND d.d_dow = 1 GROUP BY y.trip_date, w.prcp_mm, w.snow_mm, w.tmax_c, w.tmin_c ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
